use default

let sieve_limit = 10_000_100
let composite = LIST(sieve_limit)

(0::sieve_limit) |> each(_ => composite.add(false))

for candidate in 2::sieve_limit do
    if !composite[candidate] /\ candidate <= sieve_limit / candidate then
        let multiple mut = candidate * candidate

        while multiple <= sieve_limit do
            composite[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + candidate
        od
    fi
od

neighbourhoods() -> Pipe[LIST[int]] =>
    (2::sieve_limit)
        |> filter(candidate => !composite[candidate])
        |> windows(3)

strong() -> Pipe[int] =>
    neighbourhoods()
        |> filter(around => around[1] * 2 > around[0] + around[2])
        |> map(around => around[1])

weak() -> Pipe[int] =>
    neighbourhoods()
        |> filter(around => around[1] * 2 < around[0] + around[2])
        |> map(around => around[1])

report(name: string, found: () -> Pipe[int], wanted: int) is
    write_line("first {wanted} {name} primes:")
    write_line("  {found() |> take(wanted) |> join(" ")}")

    for bound in [1_000_000, 10_000_000] do
        let total = found() |> take_while(prime => prime < bound) |> count()

        write_line("  {name} primes below {bound}: {total}")
    od
si

report("strong", strong, 36)
report("weak", weak, 37)
